title: UpdateConflictReason
description: Why an update was refused in conflict: pinned (another version is pinned), current (that version runs already), schema (its database schema is below the database's), launcher (it needs a newer launcher, with no stepping stone), in_progress (an update is draining or switching), no_release_access (no forge account can read the releases), install (the launcher refused to install the version: data.launcherReason says why) or no_launcher (no launcher runs the environment to switch its version: a foreground serve, or a container whose update no host-side updater takes).
